backend_type.description: Backend database type (e.g., 'mdb' for Lightning Memory-Mapped DB, 'hdb' for hierarchical BDB).

additional_schemas.description: List of extra schema names (without .schema extension) to include (e.g., ['inetorgperson', 'nis']).

enable_default_acl.description: If true, set a basic default ACL: authenticated users get read access; anonymous users get none.

acls.description: List of custom ACL directives (full lines to insert as-is). Each entry must be a valid slapd ACL line.

pidfile_path.description: Path to the PID file for the slapd process.

argsfile_path.description: Path to the argsfile used to pass runtime arguments.

loglevel.description: Debug log level (0 = none, 256 = stats, 16384 = trace). Higher = more verbose.

tls_cipher_suite.description: OpenSSL cipher suite string for TLS (e.g., 'HIGH:MEDIUM:!aNULL:!MD5').

tls_cert_file.description: Path to the server certificate file.

tls_cert_key_file.description: Path to the server private key file.

tls_ca_cert_file.description: Path to the CA certificate file (optional, used for client cert verification).

security_require_tls.description: If true, require TLS/SSL for all operations (enforces SSF ≥ 1).

security_require_ssf.description: Minimum Security Strength Factor required for certain operations (e.g., 1 for basic TLS).

security_require_authc.description: If true, require authentication for many operations.

listeners.description: List of listener endpoints. Each entry defines scheme, optional host, and optional port.

host.description: Host/IP to bind to (e.g., '127.0.0.1'). If null or empty, default binding is used.

port.description: Port number (e.g., 389 for LDAP, 636 for LDAPS). If null and scheme='ldapi', port is omitted.

databases.description: List of database backends. Each entry defines a suffix and its backend parameters.

suffix.description: Root DN suffix for this database (e.g., 'dc=example,dc=com').

rootdn.description: DN for the administrative user of this database.

rootpw.description: Encrypted password for rootdn (e.g., '{SSHA}...'). Leave empty if managed externally.

directory.description: Directory where database files are stored.

index.description: List of attribute indexes for performance.

overlay.description: List of overlays to enable for this database (e.g., 'ppolicy', 'syncprov').

rootdn.description: Global root DN (if not defined per-database). Prefer per-database rootdn when using multiple DBs.

rootpw_hash.description: Hashed root password for global rootdn (e.g., 'xyz...' for {SSHA}). Not used if rootdn is defined per database.

monitoring_enabled.description: If true, enable the monitor backend for live server statistics (requires moduleload).
